protocol.title: Frozen known-template layered scene integration audit
protocol.visibilityRule: Count final visible target alpha>32; alpha is evaluated after pixel scoring and is never passed into inference.

oracle.algorithm: Frozen pixel template matcher with clean-background reference

protocol.pointAccuracy: Visible target required; distance from refined point to rendered rectangle center <= half cell diagonal +1px.
protocol.quantumMass: Independent exact marked/unmarked aggregate formula; known marked count first peak. Includes accidental true-point mass on unmarked states; empty oracle contributes zero.
protocol.measurement: One ideal Born sample per predefined probe; report separately from exact mass.
protocol.constructedFullCover: Additional full rectangle copies clean-background pixels over target; a control, not a claim that every real preset can cover every size.
protocol.scope: Same known verified OpenMoji-derived PNG identity at each configured size, same selected paintings, exact clean background; no arbitrary-upload or QNN generalization claim.
